text:
**None of the datasets show forest on this property in 2020.**

- **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (V4)**, the 2020 reference, shows 0 ha of forest, or 0% of the 2,843 ha property.
- **Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change (v1.13)** shows only 23 ha of tree cover (≥30% canopy) in the year 2000, not 2020. It also records tree-cover loss in 2008, 2015, 2017 and 2020, including 67.7 ha in 2020. That is consistent with little or no forest remaining at the end of 2020, though it does not directly measure 2020 forest status. The loss total is larger than the 23 ha of 2000 cover, which I can't explain from this output, so it's worth checking.

The MGAP 2021 source was not available, so it could not be used as a cross-check.
